Maya (Marketing): Need a quick greenlight for the Selene Systems customer story + 30s clip. Target publish: 2026-07-10. Can we get quote+logo approvals and lead routing by EOD tomorrow?
Ethan (Growth): We'll need 30s + 15s ad cut. UTM: utm_campaign=selene_case_q3. Will route leads into SFDC campaign and a 5-email HubSpot nurture.
Luis (CS): Customer gave a quote but included an internal job title that they'd prefer anonymized. I'll send a publication-friendly variant and a DocuSign for logo use.
Claire (Legal): Please remove job IDs and any contract references. If customer signs the DocuSign with logo consent, we're good. Otherwise we must redact those fields.
Maya (Marketing): Creative brief: open 3s brand lockup, 22s quote, 5s CTA. Subtitles: EN burned. Lower-third: "Selene Systems 1: Senior Platform Lead" (or anonymized per CS).
Luis (CS): Sent DocuSign with checkbox for logo + quote + webinar participation. Customer responded: ok to publish with "Senior Platform Lead" instead of exact title.
Claire (Legal): Approved. No PII present. Good to proceed.
Ethan (Growth): LaunchBot, create draft SFDC campaign: Selene_Q3_CaseLaunch_2026 and HubSpot workflow Selene_Nurture_5d.
LaunchBot: Draft campaign created: Selene_Q3_CaseLaunch_2026. HubSpot workflow: Selene_Nurture_5d. Use /launch finalize to activate.
Maya (Marketing): Great. Once assets are uploaded drop links here and LaunchBot run the pre-publish checklist (renders, exports 30/15, burned subs, CDN upload, SFDC finalize, HubSpot enable, blog schedule).
Luis (CS): DocuSign signed. Final quote: "Since moving to Redwood Dedicated we reduced inference spend by ~40% and saw faster tail latency, enabling us to ship features quicker. 1: Senior Platform Lead, Selene Systems."
Claire (Legal): Language approved. :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Scheduling final review 2026-07-10 06:00Z. Everyone please mark calendars. Closing thread 1: post when assets live. :rocket:
